positions.name: KestrelwoodKnowledgeRemovalDirective
positions.frame: what knowledge must be purged from the organization's epistemic holdings, and how is that purge commanded?
positions.why: Both expressions are imperative directives commanding the removal of Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration knowledge. They share the same directional read across dimensions: activated-negative affect (urgent purge), authority-ranking relational stance (command over recipient's epistemic state), pressure power (insistence, not request), decision-grade conviction (settled operational instruction), and present-irrealis temporal framing (desired action, not actual event). src-1 names the calibration abstractly; src-2 enumerates the concrete particulars (instrument, 88.4 MHz calibration, Quill Ashgrove's work) — the same read at different grain.
